name: status-pane
description: A pane beside the chat that shows the Chief of Staff status: tickets by group, with links to child threads and subagents.

environmentId.title: T3 environment ID
environmentId.description: The middle part of a T3 thread link, t3-thread://v2/<environment id>/<thread id>. Without it the pane shows no thread links.

autoOpen.title: Open on session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts. Off by default; /status-pane opens it.
